_comment: Gemini-cli hook output contract: raw stdout becomes a systemMessage (debug-only, not injected into model context). To inject context, the hook must emit JSON { hookSpecificOutput: { additionalContext: "..." } } on stdout. We wrap each abmind hook in `grep -v` to strip abmind's bootstrap log prefixes ([env], [memory-db], [memory-manager], [ollama-embed]) that leak onto stdout, keeping the useful markers ([abmind memory context], [Flashback], [Current time]). Then `jq -Rs` produces the structured envelope. AfterAgent records silently so no injection wrapper needed. Requires: jq, tools.enableHooks=true in ~/.gemini/settings.json.
